repository_scope: methodological validation only; independent from closed EOG-WF 3/31/3
purpose: Qualify a single fixed public sparse/dense migration GPS source for prospective within-trajectory evaluation of world-coherent temporal reachability certificates; do not score before later protocol is frozen.

fixed_source.publication: McKee et al. 2024, Estimating ungulate migration corridors from sparse movement data
fixed_source.publisher_time_field: Timestamp in Mountain Time (MT); require explicit daylight-saving timezone treatment before joining years/seasons
fixed_source.restricted_unshared_herds: Cody elk, Tex Creek mule deer, Lowman elk, Northfork elk; do not seek replacements or count their absent tracks

allowed_only: official publisher numeric version's file roster JSON
gate0_authorized_access.request_budget: one GET per endpoint, no hidden fallback, no cross-host redirects, 25s timeout and max 2 MB JSON payload each
source_acceptance: exact requested DOI and canonical publisher numeric version
exact three expected file names and original landing file IDs
no file roster pagination / missing metadata
every file strictly positive byte size and supported declared hash
only metadata digest identity, never claim verified downloaded bytes

intended_next_stage_NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED.requires_before_opening: separate, committed byte-verification and header-only transport authorization
intended_next_stage_NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED.primary_question: Can a frozen 12h-input finite-world reachability envelope conservatively cover withheld intermediate 2h observed GPS positions while avoiding trivial near-total geographic coverage?
intended_next_stage_NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED.primary_guardrail: false exclusion of heldout GPS fixes at predeclared resolution, with uncertainty buffer and declared candidate-domain denominator
intended_next_stage_NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED.paired_spatial_efficiency: possible-set area / predeclared candidate domain, to penalize vacuous overwide envelopes
external_comparators: 12h straight-line interpolation corridor with predeclared buffer
12h-derived Brownian bridge or published FMV reference if implemented without accessing 2h holdout
intended_next_stage_NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED.unit_of_analysis: migration sequence grouped by AID, SeasonYr and herd; repeated fixes are not independent replicates
intended_next_stage_NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED.holdout: 2h fixes strictly between adjacent 12h sparse fixes; exclude shared 12h anchors from validation scoring
intended_next_stage_NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED.score_status: NOT_FROZEN_AND_NOT_RUN; exact spatial worlds, grid resolution, buffer, eligibility, model scales, comparator implementation, split and uncertainty treatment must be written and code-frozen before 2h rows are accessed
intended_next_stage_NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED.external_validity_limit: same original tracks subsampled at 12h: within-track temporal holdout, not independent animals/populations or proof of historical pathway
intended_next_stage_NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED.no_promotion: cannot be a fourth EOG-WF endpoint; adverse/STOP outcomes preserved; no score-based choice of a different dataset
